system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The Tool Agent’s input includes only the tool document, the query, and some previous content from the Strategy Block
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent prompts filled with query/tool docs; no code released.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the Tool Agent utilizes the output of the Thought Agent to generate a suitable function expression
env_context_strategy.note: Environment knowledge gathered via tool calls (FlightSearch, etc.).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we implement a stack-like structure within the Knowledge Block. When the Plan Agent needs detailed information, the block only “pops out” the information collected over the past two days
context_compaction.note: Knowledge/Strategy Blocks replace raw history with structured state.

observation_format.evidence_quote: We directly specify each data’s name just before presenting the data, like: Flight Number: F3502691

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the Tool Agent tasked with generating the correct function expression format messages
tool_call_format.note: Text-emitted function expressions parsed by harness; exact syntax not shown.

tool_count.note: Toolbox shows FlightSearch, AttractionSearch, DailyPlanner, ... with ellipsis; full count not given.

edit_primitive.note: Only search/planning tools; no file editing.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The Tool Agent’s input includes only the tool document, the query

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: the current tools within our framework are limited. Enhancing the framework by incorporating more advanced tools

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each time the Plan Agent generates a daily plan, it creates several plans based on the same information. An Evaluate Agent reviews each plan
loop_primitives.note: Three fixed phases: Outline Generation, Information Collection, Plan Making.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: In the Outline Generation phase, LLM agents produce rough plans and identify key inform
planning_granularity.note: Outline (per-day rough plan) is produced first, then detailed plans; multiple agents (Plan Agent, Evaluate Agent) handle phases. Closest value; could be explicit_plan_object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we generate a travel planning outline using multi-agent collaboration, where each agent contributes to a specific part of our travel outline
multi_agent_topology.note: Specialised agents (PathFinder, Keypoints, Commonsense, Thought, Tool, Description, Plan, Evaluate) in fixed sequence.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the selected information is forwarded to the Plan Agent for generating the daily travel plan

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: An Evaluate Agent reviews each plan, converting them into JSON format and using code to identify and rank errors
human_in_loop.note: Fully automated loop; no human gate described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The Strategy Block also informs the Thought Agent which day it is in the travel plan and short descriptions of the collected data.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: this block will automatically record all information and the description of each information
long_term_memory.note: Knowledge Block is within-run only; no cross-run memory described.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: If errors persist after this second attempt, we proceed with the process regardless.

self_verification.evidence_quote: An Evaluate Agent reviews each plan, converting them into JSON format and using code to identify and rank errors. Based on these evaluations, we select the best plan.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: we limit the maximum number of retries to 3 to prevent infinite remaking of the travel route
retry_policy.note: Also a single revert to information collection if all plans err.

rollback.evidence_quote: the plans with errors are discarded. This discard process occurs only once per day’s plan

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Measures if agents can successfully deliver a final plan within a set number of steps (max 45).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: we set the temperature to 0 for all processes except for Plan Agent, where it is set to 0.7

timeouts.evidence_quote: Failure includes dead loops, numerous failed attempts, or exceeding the step limit.
timeouts.note: Step caps only, no time limits stated.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We ran open-source models on 4 NVIDIA RTX A6000.
execution_isolation.note: Actions are benchmark API/tool calls, no sandbox described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: the Tool Agent calls the DailyPlanner tool, and the Plan Agent creates the daily plan

tracing.evidence_quote: we visualized the error distribution from GPT-4-Turbo in Fig 4

replayability.evidence_quote: To ensure the reproducibility of our experimental results, we set the temperature to 0 for all processes except for Plan Agent

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: We use the same metrics proposed in TravelPlanner [54].
eval_hooks.note: Evaluate Agent uses code-based constraint checks; benchmark metrics from TravelPlanner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: if the route cannot be reached by any means of transportation, we provide the feedback to the PathFinder Agent and prompt the agent to revise the route

target_domain.evidence_quote: we concentrate on travel planning, a Multi-Phases planning problem
target_domain.note: Travel planning domain; no listed value fits.

open_source.evidence_quote: Future work can focus on applying our planning framework to real-world planning problems in practical environments.
open_source.note: No repository URL or licence given.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We use gpt-3.5-turbo-1106, gpt-4-1106-preview, mixtral, mistral-7B-32K in our experiments

first_release_date.note: Basis: arXiv v1 date; no release.
